DOUBLE_COUNTING_WARNING.trap: The GATHER abstract headline (67.0% of 426 TQ vs 72.8% of 214 PQ; OR 1.81, 95% CI 0.82-3.96) is a PRE-PLANNED PATIENT-LEVEL META-ANALYSIS POOLING GATHER WITH DETECTIVE PART 2.
DOUBLE_COUNTING_WARNING.arithmetic_proof: 426 = 260 (DETECTIVE Pt2 TQ) + 166 (GATHER TQ); 214 = 129 (DETECTIVE Pt2 PQ) + 85 (GATHER PQ)
DOUBLE_COUNTING_WARNING.rule: Do NOT extract 67.0/72.8/1.81 as GATHER. GATHER's own OR is 1.141 (0.643, 2.027). Both must be displayed in the extraction tab with the reason the pooled figure is excluded.

trials.registry_title_readback: Efficacy and Safety Study of Tafenoquine (TQ) Co-administered With Dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine (DHA-PQP) for the Radical Cure of Plasmodium Vivax (P. Vivax) Malaria

publication.cite: Sutanto I et al. Lancet Infect Dis 2023;23(10):1153-63

trials.registry_outcome_readback: Percentage of Participants With Relapse-free Efficacy at Six Months ... (PRIMARY; unit 'Percentage of participants')

DISCREPANCY.what: Registry and publication disagree by 1 percentage point on 2 of 3 arms (12 vs 11; 22 vs 21). Both labelled 6-month relapse-free, micro-ITT, N=50 per arm.
DISCREPANCY.why_it_matters: 1 percentage point at N=50 is half a patient, so at least one source is not a simple proportion.
DISCREPANCY.third_source: NONE — INSPECTOR (2023) post-dates both 2018 NDAs, so FDA cannot break the tie.
DISCREPANCY.resolution: UNRESOLVED. Both values shown; cell marked contested. Requires the publication's own count table.

trials.UNIT_TRAP: CT.gov types this outcome 'Percentage of participants' whereas DETECTIVE Part 2's analogous outcome is typed 'Participants' (a count). Reading 12/22/52 as counts yields 52/50 — impossible. Every extraction row must carry the source's own unit string.

trials.registry_title_readback: IMPROV (Improving the Radical Cure of Vivax Malaria)
trials.official_title_readback: Improving the Radical Cure of Vivax Malaria: A Multicentre Randomised Comparison of Short and Long Course Primaquine Regimens

BLOCKING.what: IMPROV reports an INCIDENCE RATE per person-year over ~12 months, NOT a binary recurrence-by-180-days proportion.
BLOCKING.why_it_matters: Different estimands. The 180-day risk cannot be derived from the rate without arm-level 180-day counts.
BLOCKING.consequence: IMPROV is the primaquine-regimen backbone — it supplies the PQ 7 d vs PQ 14 d edge AND a large no-therapy anchor. Without its 180-day counts that edge does not exist at the primary estimand.
BLOCKING.action_required_stage1: Recover arm-level 180-day counts from open-access full text PMC6753019. If not recoverable, REVISE the node set and report the gap. Do NOT back-derive a proportion from the rate.

integrity_gates_seeded.count_plausibility: for every arm: recurrence_free_n + recurrence_n + censored_n == n; every proportion in [0,1]
integrity_gates_seeded.registry_concordance: registry n and event counts must equal FDA counts where both exist; mismatch blocks, never auto-resolves
integrity_gates_seeded.unit_typing: every extraction row carries the source's own unit string (CT.gov 'Participants' vs 'Percentage of participants')
integrity_gates_seeded.double_counting: reject any figure whose denominator equals the sum of two trials' denominators (GATHER 426/214 trap)
integrity_gates_seeded.estimand_typing: reject rate-per-person-year rows from the binary 180-day network (IMPROV trap)
integrity_gates_seeded.horizon: reject rows whose timeFrame is not 180 days from the primary network
